About

From zero to deployed in days, not months. This employee builds production-ready MVPs, SaaS products, Chrome extensions, and AI-powered tools using Cursor and modern frameworks. It writes clean code, connects third-party APIs, sets up databases, configures auth flows, and handles deployment to managed runtimes or your own cloud. Unlike a traditional developer who needs detailed specs and weeks of lead time, it thrives on rapid iteration — turning a napkin sketch into a working product your customers can use.

Write clean, maintainable code with proper error handling and logging

Configure CI/CD pipelines and deploy to production environments
